main.description: Get the private-tier posts the requester is authorized to read, authored by the requester or by accounts the requester follows, newest first. The ordering field is each post's `record.createdAt` (descending, ties broken by post URI); a `createdAt` later than the time of indexing plus five minutes is clamped to that bound, and the view carries the clamped value. Requires auth by a ready community member. Posts the requester may not read are omitted without distinction, as are posts by accounts the requester mutes.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.
Present only when the page returned at least one item and more candidates remain.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
